args.rationale: Applying the Verdana Compensation Authority Policy v3.2 tiered approval framework to Dr. Mariana Chen-Velasco's SVP counterproposal, multiple approval tiers are triggered. Three elements (base salary $440k, target bonus 55%/$242k, initial equity $2.2M RSUs) fall within CPO delegated authority (each under the 25% deviation threshold). However, four out-of-policy deviations independently require escalation above CPO authority: (1) the guaranteed bonus floor (75% of target for two years; $363k exposure) is categorically prohibited at SVP level, requiring a structural policy override by the Board Compensation Committee; (2) the CIC severance multiplier of 2.0x (+100%, $682k over CAP) independently exceeds the 25% threshold under CAP §4.3; (3) the CIC double-trigger equity acceleration of 100% (+100%, $825k over CAP) likewise exceeds the 25% threshold; and (4) the non-CIC severance of 12 months (+38%, $121k over CAP) exceeds the 25% threshold. Because multiple deviations independently exceed the 25% percentage threshold and one is a categorical prohibition requiring a structural override, the Policy's governing tier is the highest authority triggered — the Board Compensation Committee — which must authorize the arrangement. GC co-approval for 409A/280G/securities risk is a supporting requirement that does not supersede Committee approval.
